title: Nisha Traders: one year's figures
body: Nisha Traders deals in electronic goods. For the year ended 31 March 2026 its records show: revenue from sales Rs 9,00,000; commission received Rs 30,000; cost of goods sold Rs 6,00,000; salaries Rs 1,20,000; rent Rs 60,000; electricity Rs 20,000. During the year, old office furniture that had cost Rs 50,000 was sold for Rs 58,000. Goods costing Rs 15,000 were destroyed in a fire and nothing was recovered from insurance; these goods are not included in the cost of goods sold. The business also bought a new delivery van for Rs 4,00,000, which it expects to use for about six years.
